topics.title: Challenge cardinality
topics.reason: The North Star intentionally uses neutral Challenge(s) wording and does not decide whether one Journey has exactly one Challenge or may have multiple Challenges.

moves.reason: Originally targeted to PH-004, Challenge cardinality was resolved earlier in PH-003 by PD-014. Correct the recorded target to the resolving phase; Challenge lifecycle mechanics remain deferred to PH-004 under DT-007.

topics.notes: Resolved in PH-003 by PD-014: multiple Journey-specific undertakings are supported; आव्हान is optional, not exactly one mandatory Challenge. The original PH-004 target is preserved in move history. Challenge lifecycle mechanics remain in PH-004 under DT-007; related Journey completion mechanics remain DT-015.

topics.title: Feature-level Vratamitra information, actions, and permissions
topics.reason: Do not globally enumerate exact visibility, actions, contributions, validation, chat or reference behavior, and permissions before the relevant features are designed. Derive information, access, ownership, Primary versus Journey Vratamitra scope, and historical behavior as each feature is modeled.
topics.notes: Cross-cutting: revisit for chat, Journey evidence, Exposures, Resolutions, Challenges, reassessment, resources, AI summaries, and other feature-design phases. Include exact post-relationship access to feature-specific artifacts after their ownership/participation models and permissions are designed; former-Primary status alone does not grant continuing broad Primary-level access. Do not invent access categories here. Reconcile completed-Journey visibility and post-relationship access for former Journey Vratamitras under PH-008 and PH-011; Journey completion does not itself determine that access. PD-014 confirms Journey Vratamitra custom suggestions and Vratarthi final authority; exact contribution actions and visibility remain for feature-level permissions. References to possible features here do not approve new ontology entities.

topics.title: Community moderation actions and escalation
topics.reason: PD-011 confirms Moderator purpose at the actor level; exact moderation scopes, visibility rules, actions, reports, restrictions, removal, and escalation remain deferred until community features and content types are modeled, with permission reconciliation in PH-008.
topics.notes: Original intake context (preserved): Include moderation of user-generated/community content for different visibility contexts, and exact scopes, visibility rules, actions, and permissions; reconcile permission implications in PH-008. Current actor purpose is preserved in PD-011. Resolved conceptually in PH-006 by PD-030: moderation purposes, reporting/review/actions, privacy boundary and separate personal blocking. Exact policy/authority and detailed flows remain DT-029/030, coordinated with DT-012; no automated enforcement or unrestricted private access is approved.

topics.title: Resource structure, relationships, curation, and promotion
topics.reason: Curators steward centrally curated or endorsed resources, while approval, promotion, featuring, pinning, official status, recommendations, collections, and entity-linking mechanics should be decided per content type.
topics.notes: PD-021/022/023 resolve conceptual scope: knowledge standing/stewardship, generic nested Sections, types/tags/developmental associations, current-content references, and Curator-managed undertaking catalog items (earlier shared suggestions). No dedicated Vratarthi submission/promotion workflow, separate Collection, mandatory editorial approval/history, undertaking recommendation engine, or formal Resource–Undertaking association is in current scope. Original reason examples do not approve pinning or other mechanisms. Residual discovery/prominence/authoring/reference experiences are DT-027; authority is DT-012 and access/publishing/deletion policy DT-028. DT-017 retains authored-content/community relationships in PH-006 with PH-008 reconciliation; technical editor/representation choices remain DT-020. No automatic promotion or private-content access is granted.

topics.title: Authentication methods, account-linking, and return-to-context UX
topics.reason: Public visitors may encounter actions that require registration or login; preserve the attempted context and design the return behavior when authentication journeys are specified.
topics.notes: Supported authentication providers, account-linking flows, login/signup screens, and authentication-return behavior remain undecided. Multiple methods authenticate the same persistent account/Vratarthi identity under PD-011. Implementation and token/session architecture remain outside this ontology cluster and belong to later implementation work.

topics.title: Under-18 public access and age-gating details
topics.reason: Sign-up is restricted to age 18+, but public browsing, age declaration or verification, rationale and communication, and related access behavior remain undecided.
topics.notes: Also reconcile age-gated public journeys and edge cases in PH-011.

topics.title: Challenge application semantics
topics.reason: Challenge(s) contribute to application and evidence of developmental change; lifecycle, repeatability, success and completion semantics, authoring or selection, and relationship to Journey completion remain undecided.
topics.notes: Resolved conceptually in PH-004 by PD-017/018: parameters, flexible lifecycle, prospective revision/new-undertaking judgment, optional guide involvement, honest accounts, and parent conclusion are established. Residual UX/timing/history/permissions remain DT-021/023/025/002; no historical thresholds or mandatory Challenge are imported.

topics.title: Notification and re-engagement model
topics.reason: The notification constraint in PD-006 is confirmed; the notification and re-engagement model and its mechanics are intentionally left for later design.
topics.notes: Later decisions include notification-producing events; recipients; urgency and importance; in-app notification center/activity model; reminders and re-engagement; email, push, and in-app channels; timing; batching and deduplication; read, unread, and actioned state; preferences and controls; notification-to-action navigation; ignored or expired notifications; and anti-dependency/anti-nagging behavior. Reconcile the experience in PH-011; carry relevant implications into PH-013 through PH-016. Do not decide these mechanics in this record. PH-006 PD-027 confirms no explicit notification of a declined follow request. Reconcile other confirmed community events under PD-006 without optimizing popularity or dependence; exact notification mechanics remain open.

topics.title: Automatic Vratamitra invitation expiry
topics.reason: The confirmed Primary Vratamitra lifecycle leaves automatic invitation expiry undecided; it establishes acceptance, withdrawal, and decline states but no automatic expiry rule.

moves.reason: PH-002 has established acceptance, withdrawal, decline, replacement, terminal states, and Journey-completion closure. Automatic time-based expiry and its duration are not required to complete the actor/relationship model; PH-011 can decide this later journey/state/UX policy with actual invitation flows and the notification/re-engagement model available.

topics.notes: Also covers automatic expiry and expiry timing for specific-person Journey Vratamitra invitations. Closing a pending Journey invitation on Journey completion is confirmed in PD-008 and is distinct from an undecided time-based expiry rule.

topics.title: Canonical identity/account ontology
topics.reason: PH-002 confirms participation and capability roles without establishing account or database entity structure. PH-003 must define the relationship between person, signed-in user/account, Vratarthi, profile, roles/capabilities, and relationship assignments while preserving that every signed-in user is a Vratarthi.
topics.notes: Resolved by PD-011: Account, persistent Vratarthi identity, automatic Profile, authentication state/methods, granted capabilities, contextual roles, and relationship assignments are conceptually distinguished; no separate Person entity is currently needed. Profile details, account exit, and UX/permission mechanics remain separately deferred.

topics.title: Invitation flows and guidance mode-switch UX edge cases
topics.reason: PH-002 establishes domain invitation and guidance semantics, while exact invitation flows, changing pending invitees, confirmation dialogs, and mode-switch UX edge cases require later user-journey design.
topics.notes: Reconcile pending replacement invitations when another explicit mode change occurs and the actual invitation/solo-to-guidance flows. Preserve accepted domain rules; time-based expiry remains DT-009 and notification mechanics remain DT-008. Include general Veervrat invitations and guidance invitations to registered or unregistered recipients: link/token structure, delivery, matching, routing, recipient choices, registration followed by explicit relationship acceptance, and pending invitation UX. Do not infer a Person entity or change accepted lifecycle semantics.

topics.title: Platform-capability grants, revocation, and Admin authority
topics.reason: PD-011 establishes Curator, Moderator, and Admin as granted platform capabilities, while exact granting authority, permission scopes, revocation, and operational mechanics remain deferred to permissions/privacy design.
topics.notes: Extend the existing Admin authority question to exact granting authority, permission scopes, revocation, and operational mechanics for explicitly granted Curator, Moderator, and Admin capabilities. Vratamitra requires no separate platform-role grant under PD-011; contextual roles do not inherently grant unrestricted permissions. Include PH-005 Resource/catalog publishing, editing, withdrawal, foundational/official standing, and centrally managed type/tag authority under PD-021/022/023; exact access/deletion policy is DT-028. Conceptual Curator stewardship does not grant unrestricted authority. Explicitly retain exact authority to create, modify, retire or otherwise maintain entries in all four PD-013 developmental catalogs: गुण, उपगुण, उणीवा and गुणदर्शक विधाने. Coordinate maintenance experiences with DT-027, historical effects with DT-025 and continuity with DT-020; no maintenance mechanics or Resource lifecycle/history semantics are assigned to these catalogs here.

topics.title: Account exit and lifecycle policy
topics.reason: Account deactivation and deletion are legitimate concepts to consider, but their behavior is not established by the identity ontology cluster.
topics.notes: Decide deactivation, permanent deletion, identity termination, data retention, historical Vratamitra relationship implications, contributions/content after exit, and account-management UX. No exit semantics are established yet.

topics.title: Profile details, visibility, editing, and presentation
topics.reason: PD-011 establishes an automatic Profile distinct from account identity, including before optional details are supplied; actual fields, public visibility, editing permissions, and Profile UI are not decided.

moves.reason: PD-015 captures the conceptual boundary: Profile information is separate from Vratarthi-owned Journeys and assessments. Remaining Profile fields and experience belong to PH-009, permissions/visibility/editing to PH-008, and user journeys to PH-011; no additional Profile fields or behavior are required to finish this ontology cluster.

topics.notes: Keep remaining Profile fields, visibility, editing, and presentation open. A later Profile page may display developmental records without owning them. Completion remains unnecessary for participation under PD-011. Original deferral reason is retained; PD-015 addresses conceptual ownership without deciding fields, persistence, or page behavior.

topics.title: Journey, अनुभव, and संकल्प lifecycle and participation workflows
topics.reason: PD-014 confirms conceptual Journey and undertaking structure, but detailed lifecycle, completion, iteration, recurrence, exceptions, and participation workflows require PH-004 design.
topics.notes: Resolved conceptually by PD-016/017/018, including unconcluded uniqueness, conscious contexts, pause propagation, संकल्प fulfilment/revision/refinement, and conclusion prerequisites. Reiteration/refinement interaction details remain DT-021; inactivity DT-022, feedback DT-023, archive/delete DT-024, history DT-025, and permissions DT-002. Original reason and target retained.

topics.title: Self-assessment scales, scoring, and interaction mechanics
topics.reason: PD-013 confirms assessment meaning and statement selection, but not rating scales, scoring, presentation, or interactions.
topics.notes: PD-019 confirms the initial universal frequency scale and simple lower-rating recommendation order, including all-Often/Always cases. No numerical scoring formula or sophisticated engine is introduced. Count/ties/presentation/interactions remain DT-026; alternate scales/contextual algorithms remain uncommitted candidates.

topics.title: User-authored content and community participation concepts
topics.reason: PD-015 distinguishes authored content from curated Resources without approving Posts, Blogs, feeds, or other community-content mechanisms.
topics.notes: Original intake context (preserved): PD-021 confirms ordinary Vratarthi-authored material and Curator consideration for curated inclusion, without a dedicated submission/promotion workflow or private-content access. Actual forms, content types, visibility, participation mechanisms, and exact authored-content/curated-inclusion relationships remain PH-006. Decide whether Posts/Blogs/feeds or other mechanisms exist; coordinate with resolved DT-004, PD-021/023, moderation DT-003, and PH-008 permissions (DT-028). Historical Daily Logs and experience posts remain unapproved. Journey-specific versus person-to-person chat and entity/entry comments remain questions, not approved features; recording/history mechanisms remain PH-007. Resolved conceptually in PH-006: generic authored content and its publication lifecycle, discussion/appreciation, following, audiences/defaults and private communication. No separate Post/Blog/Daily Log entities or feed/recommendation mechanism is inferred. Remaining policy/experience is DT-029/030; curated-inclusion boundaries remain DT-028 and practice history DT-025.

topics.title: Broader Veervrat progression, milestones, and readiness
topics.reason: Whether multiple Journeys and aggregate completed अनुभव, संकल्प, and आव्हाने contribute to a broader milestone or readiness to formally undertake Veervrat remains undecided.
topics.notes: PD-020 resolves current scope as continuous development through individual Journeys without aggregate counts, targets, levels, readiness thresholds, or a distinct mandatory formal milestone. A separate formal milestone remains only an uncommitted future candidate, not an open obligation or a philosophical rejection of wider tradition.

topics.title: Final name for गुणदर्शक विधान / Virtue Expression
topics.reason: PD-013 confirms the concept and bilingual definition but both names remain provisional.
topics.notes: PH-012 is the current target for final product-language naming, not a restriction on earlier review: the provisional names may be reconsidered before PH-012. Preserve the agreed concept and do not make personal statements/catalogs an approved feature.

topics.title: Existing-to-target architecture and incremental transition plan
topics.reason: The confirmed redesign-first direction completes holistic design through PH-016 before incremental implementation in the existing app context; architecture, migration, rollout, and sequencing remain to be designed.
topics.notes: Evaluate retention/refactoring/redesign/replacement/removal/supplementation against the approved target, not reuse by default or indiscriminate rewrite. Include feasibility, implementation readiness, existing accounts/auth identities, guidance/invitations, Journeys/undertakings, assessments/catalogs/resources/authored content, historical contributions/access, data transformations or legacy preservation, compatibility, continuity, validation, safe release/recovery, and design QA. Plan/specify here; implementation and migration execution follow afterward. No current architecture, stack, auth, connectivity, infrastructure, or pipelines are approved for retention by existence. PH-005 leaves technical editor architecture, content representation/storage, and integration undecided; coordinate Markdown versus rich-text/block experience choices with DT-027 and component/interaction/screen design in PH-013–015. Explicitly include data continuity and transition implications when गुण, उपगुण, उणीवा or गुणदर्शक विधान catalog entries change, including existing assessments, Journeys, references and historical records. Coordinate unresolved semantics with DT-025/012/027; do not choose change-propagation or version-history mechanics here. PH-006 adds implementation/representation of confirmed authored content, following, audiences/defaults, communication and moderation/blocking, including editor/communication architecture and migration/continuity. This selects no technical model or unapproved messaging feature; preserve redesign-first existing-to-target evaluation.

topics.title: Practice experience, navigation, and detailed participation flows
topics.reason: PH-004 establishes conceptual practice semantics without fixing indicators, controls, navigation, screens, or detailed flows.
topics.notes: Include existing-Journey indicators, conscious discovery-context association, planning/revision/replacement/withdrawal/reiteration/refinement interactions, pause/resume and conclusion controls, and logical prerequisite presentation. PH-011 must address detailed independent cancellation/withdrawal of never-started undertakings; the parent-Journey-conclusion account exception does not apply to those independent cases. Do not reopen settled semantics or impose a rigid self-review/feedback sequence.

topics.title: Journey inactivity thresholds and detailed pause interactions
topics.reason: PD-016 distinguishes lifecycle and observed engagement but deliberately leaves inactivity policy details unresolved.
topics.notes: Decide threshold duration, scope (platform/विधान/Journey/other), configurability and authority, exact qualifying events, and detailed inactivity/pause interactions. Preserve purposeful recorded Vratarthi activity, no reset by views or guide activity alone, no inactivity accumulation during deliberate pause, and no compulsory check-in schedule.

topics.title: Journey completion perspective request timing and interaction
topics.reason: PD-018 requires requesting the effective Journey Vratamitra's perspective before completion, without a response requirement or veto, but not an exact wait or interaction order.
topics.notes: Set reasonable non-response waiting duration and detailed request/self-review interactions. Preserve meaningful request/response history; do not require feedback on discontinuation or from an unrelated Primary, invent notification mechanics (DT-008), or prescribe self-review ordering prematurely.

topics.title: Journey and undertaking archiving, deletion, retention, and restoration
topics.reason: PH-004 distinguishes discontinuation, archiving, and deletion without deciding data-management or visibility policy.
topics.notes: Decide archiving, eligible lifecycle states, restoration, deletion, retention, cascading effects, and permissions. Neither universally forbid deletion nor turn archive/delete into lifecycle states. Preserve account-exit ownership separately under DT-013.

topics.title: Practice history, revisions, accounts, and reflection mechanisms
topics.reason: PH-004 requires meaningful practice and guidance history but not exact event/history models or recording mechanisms.
topics.notes: Model chronological discovery contexts, original/changed commitments and reasons, revisions/replacements/withdrawals, conclusion accounts, and guidance request/response history. Examine reflection, feedback, observations, references, and evidence mechanisms without assuming a specific feature/entity is approved; access remains PH-008 and deletion DT-024. Reconcile implications of changes to PD-013's गुण, उपगुण, उणीवा and गुणदर्शक विधान catalogs for existing assessments, Journeys, references and historical records. Exact maintenance authority remains DT-012 (PH-008), authoring/change interactions DT-027 (PH-009/011), and data continuity/transition DT-020 (PH-016). No Resource current-content-reference, lifecycle, snapshot or version-history rule is applied to developmental catalogs by assumption. PH-006 distinguishes community content/comments/messages from personal practice records and formal feedback. Determine how meaningful guidance, observations and communication become developmental history, and relevant historical consequences of community/guidance changes. Do not automatically turn all messages into Journey history or preapprove practice-record comments/reactions.

topics.title: Assessment recommendation count, ties, presentation, and interaction
topics.reason: PD-019 settles initial scale and recommendation priorities but not exact recommendation count, tie-breaking, presentation, or interaction mechanics.
topics.notes: Keep any assessed विधान selectable and preserve comparatively lower-rated recommendations even when all responses are Often/Always. Do not turn future contextual/history algorithms or alternate scales into implementation requirements.

topics.title: Knowledge discovery, authoring, and reference experiences
topics.reason: PH-005 confirms knowledge and catalog concepts without deciding discovery, prominence, editor experience, detailed authoring journeys, or reference interactions.
topics.notes: Design browsing/search/navigation, foundational/official/curated standing and prominence, Resource/Section discovery via types/tags/developmental links, relevant undertaking catalog selection, and optional विधान-description presentation in assessment/browsing/Journeys. PH-011 owns detailed create/edit/publish/withdraw, reference and unavailable-reference interactions. Markdown versus rich-text/block editor remains open for experience and PH-016 architecture (DT-020); components, motion/interactions and screens belong to PH-013–015. Evaluate genuine discovery needs without treating old pinning/recommendation examples as approved features or introducing Collections, submission workflows, mandatory Resource history, or an undertaking recommendation engine. Explicitly retain maintenance/authoring experiences and detailed change/retirement interactions for PD-013's गुण, उपगुण, उणीवा and गुणदर्शक विधान catalogs, coordinated with authority in DT-012, assessment/Journey/reference/history implications in DT-025 and data continuity in DT-020. This deferral does not impose Resource lifecycle or version-history semantics on developmental catalogs.

topics.title: Resource and undertaking-catalog access and lifecycle policy
topics.reason: PH-005 establishes conceptual Curator stewardship and current-content references without exact audience, contribution, publishing, withdrawal, deletion, retention, or access rules.
topics.notes: Set Resource/catalog publishing, editing, withdrawal and access policy, foundational-standing changes, classification/tag management permissions, authored-content privacy and curated inclusion, and Resource deletion/retention/reference-access rules. Coordinate capability grants/authority with DT-012, guidance contribution access with DT-002, authored-content concepts with DT-017 and detailed unavailable-reference interactions with DT-027. No automatic promotion, private-Journey access, permanent retention, unrestricted deletion, mandatory historical snapshot or public-access policy is inferred. Personal practice deletion remains DT-024; account exit DT-013. PH-006 / PD-025 reconciles authored content versus curated Resources conceptually, preserving original authorship and no automatic promotion/private access. Exact curated-inclusion/access/publishing policy remains open here; PH-006 working drafts are not imposed on Resources.

topics.title: Community permissions, privacy, and lifecycle policy
topics.reason: PH-006 confirms community concepts without detailed audience, relationship-access, moderation-authority, blocking or retention policy.
topics.notes: Define exact audiences including Public Visitor access; actual initial category defaults and their effects on existing items; inheritance/exceptions across Journeys, undertakings, practice records, discussion and references; following-list visibility, reaction-giver identity visibility, message eligibility restrictions and post-relationship access; blocking/unblocking consequences for pending/active following, guidance, communication and history. Define moderation/report material access, privacy, authority, restrictions and escalation, and authored-content/comment/message/relationship/report removal, retention and restoration policy, including audience changes and unpublish/republish. Coordinate DT-002/012/013/014/024/028 without replacing their guidance, capability, account-exit, Profile, personal-practice or Resource ownership. No permission matrix or mechanics are decided here.

topics.title: Community experience, terminology, and detailed flows
topics.reason: PH-006 confirms conceptual community capabilities while deferring discovery, authoring, management and detailed interaction/state rules.
topics.notes: Cover authored-content creation/discovery and nested discussion; Profile/follower/following/request-management views and timing; contextual private communication; category defaults and individual audiences; publication, optional working drafts, unpublish/republish/removal; reporting/blocking and detailed transitions. Reconcile re-request/expiry/duplicate/blocked-state interactions with DT-029 policy and notifications under DT-008, preserving no explicit follow-decline notification. Final authored-content/appreciation language belongs to PH-012; editor/component/interaction/screens to PH-013–015 and architecture to DT-020. Exact formats/media/attachments are not decided. Evaluate discovery needs without assuming a social feed, recommendation engine or every possible messaging feature.
